response.sql: SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb), AVG(patient_avg_appt_minus_pt) FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg_hgb, AVG(APPT - PT) as patient_avg_appt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) patient_avgs

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values at every step" uses standard SQL AVG() function behavior, which independently excludes NULL values from each average calculation.
